text:
I used to jump between CapCut, ChatGPT, and music tools.

Trying to make everything feel “cinematic.”

But the flow still felt off.

With @nemovideo.ai NemoVideo + Seedance 2.0, everything finally clicks.

Below is my current workflow👇 https://t.co/sCBqgeEXNo
content: Drop in an ad concept or script into NemoVideo + Seedance 2.0 to have it generate a full brand video with consistent product visuals, flowing split-screen transitions, and matched music.

thread_texts:
A cinematic product video where design, culture, and performance move as one.
